scope: Synthetic HostV25 controls; public page SVG and PDF at 1x, transparent background. Native references are bottom-up host-Mesa crops; no device or saved-note parity is established.
method: Paired public renderer profile with gradient fringe widths 1.0 and 1.1 scene units. PDF rasterized at 4/3 scale by PyMuPDF 1.28.2; support and absolute alpha error measured within each complete native crop.
svg_observation: All 26 controls had unchanged support intersection and union, and lower alpha and RGBA error with width 1.1.
conclusion: Width 1.1 worsens PDF alpha error in 25 of 26 controls with identical support; retain width 1.0. PDFium was unavailable.
reproduction: Create empty baseline and wide output directories.

Run SDOCX_SIMPLEBRUSH_EXPORT_DIR=<baseline> CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/sdocx-agent-target CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 cargo test -p sdocx --lib --features pdf,serde ink::simplebrush::tests -- --nocapture.

Temporarily change the gradient inner-radius subtraction in crates/sdocx/src/render/simplebrush.rs from 1.0 to 1.1 and repeat the same command with SDOCX_SIMPLEBRUSH_EXPORT_DIR=<wide>; restore the source afterward.

Run .venv/bin/python tmp/vector-parity-plan/pen-family-audit/simplebrush-paint-mesa-v25/compare_simplebrush_fringe_pdf.py <baseline> <wide> with PyMuPDF 1.28.2. The script reads the retained native RGBA crops and writes metric rows to stdout.
